name: Towazugatari ~Shoujo Ryoujoku Hishou~
original_name: 永遠ズ語リ～少女凌辱秘抄～
source:
Kirino Ryouko had her father, mother and beloved brother murdered by monsters in the past. She hates demons more than anyone and that's why receives exorcist training to fight them.
One day she is dispatched as a teacher to a high school where beast is noticed disguised as one of the students.
At school the most beautiful girl gets targeted and then violated by a group of hooligans possessed by spirits. Taken photos are used to blackmail her and repeat this hell on daily basis.
Eventually teacher and student meet and prepare bloody revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
桐野凉子的父母和心爱的弟弟曾被怪物杀害。她比任何人都痛恨恶魔，因此接受驱魔训练来对抗它们。
某天，她被派往一所高中当老师，那里有人发现有野兽伪装成学生潜伏。
在学校里，最美丽的女孩被盯上，然后被一群被灵体附身的流氓侵犯。拍摄的照片被用来威胁她，日复一日地重复着这种地狱。
最终，老师和学生相遇，准备进行血腥的复仇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
